lastCompletedStory.title: Create the PreToolUse deny hook script and register it in .claude/settings.json

nextStoryContext: US-002 created the PreToolUse allowlist hook (.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh, chmod+x) and registered it in .claude/settings.json under hooks.PreToolUse with matcher Task|Agent. The hook reads the spawned subagent type from three defensive field paths (.tool_input.subagent_type // .tool_input.agent_type // .agent_type) and denies anything outside {subagent-planner, subagent-auditor}. .gitignore was updated to stop ignoring .claude/hooks/ so the script can be committed. The next story (US-003) should write regression tests using synthetic payloads to lock the real production field shape - the empirically-observed payload shape for Task spawns should be captured as a fixture, not just the defensive fallback shapes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: (1) deny contract matches - exit 0 + {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName,permissionDecision:deny,permissionDecisionReason}}; (2) settings.json structure matches - hooks.PreToolUse[].matcher + .hooks[].{type,command}; (3) top-level agent_type is caller identity, spawned type lives in tool_input; (4) exit 0 is correct for JSON output, exit 2 ignores JSON.
